stem.en: A vector is translated to a different starting point without changing its length or direction. What has changed?
stem.et: Vektor nihutatakse teise alguspunkti, muutmata selle pikkust ega suunda. Mis on muutunud?

label.en: Nothing — it is the same vector, since a vector is defined by magnitude and direction alone
label.et: Mitte midagi — see on sama vektor, sest vektori määravad ainult pikkus ja suund

label.en: It is now a different vector, because its position in space is different
label.et: See on nüüd teine vektor, sest selle asukoht ruumis on erinev

label.en: Its components become negative, since it points away from the origin
label.et: Selle komponendid muutuvad negatiivseks, sest see osutab alguspunktist eemale

label.en: Its magnitude changes in proportion to how far it was moved
label.et: Selle pikkus muutub võrdeliselt nihutamise kaugusega
